details.publicNotes:
Laelapses, also called storm hounds, are supernaturally relentless predators resembling a mix of reptilian beasts and hunting dogs. These creatures are renowned for their tenacity. Legend claims that once a laelaps captures the scent of prey, it never ceases its pursuit until it or its quarry is dead.

Their superior endurance is a key part of their hunting strategy. Laelapses prefer to harry and frighten their targets, running them to exhaustion before closing in to deal the final blow.

Though in the wild they prefer storm-ravaged coastlines and floodplains, laelapses are prized companions for fey nobles and others who battle elusive foes. Laelapses aren't picky about who joins their pack, so long as the newcomers can contribute to the hunt.

Storm Riders

Laelapses can ride storms over any type of terrain in pursuit of their quarries, but the color of their scales suggests that the creatures are more at home in some environments than others. Laelapses with green or blue scales, for example, are often encountered pacing coastlines, while those with white or silver scales stalk the arctic wastes. A laelaps native to a desert region might have scales in colors of tan, yellow, crimson, or gold.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 30/65/125 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (piercing, slashing), armor (light, medium), perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Stealth, Survival)

Eligible Imbued Properties air, bane, constitution, dexterity, elongating, energy resistant (electricty, sonic, vitality), mind, mind shield, sensory (darkvision, scent), spiked, strength, wild

Trigger A creature the laelaps has designated with Hunt Prey Strides or takes an action with the teleportation trait while within the laelaps's reach

Effect The laelaps makes a jaws Strike against its prey. This Strike neither applies nor counts toward the laelaps's multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, the distance covered by the Stride or teleportation effect is reduced by half. If it critically hits, the laelaps' prey stays in place, though other creatures affected by their action can still teleport or move.

The laelaps rushes forward, propelled by screaming wind that strikes fear into those that hear it. The laelaps Strides twice. If the laelaps passes within 5 feet of an enemy during this movement, that creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23] save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

The laelaps designates a single creature it can see and hear, or one it is Tracking, as its prey. The laelaps gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception and Survival checks when Seeking and Tracking its prey. The first time each round that the laelaps hits its prey with a Strike, it deals an additional 1d8 precision damage. These effects last until it uses Hunt Prey again.

Frequency Once per minute

Requirements The laelaps is grappled, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3], or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]

Effect The laelaps removes any one of the listed conditions, but increases its drained value by 1 for 1 hour. This increase is cumulative with other uses of Relentless Pursuit, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4}. The laelaps can take this action even when a condition would normally prevent it from taking actions.
The laelaps can walk on air as if it were solid ground while in an area of stormy or violent weather. It can ascend or descend at a maximum of a 45-degree angle.
